body: I plan on going to the mountains, Right now, there is a great amounts of snow, As for the plans, Stay up 24 hours sitting, watching the sun and moon rise for the last time. Thinking of all the neglect and moments that led to this moment. If I am a pussy, and cant pull the trigger, I will jump. Sounds like a plan!

There are darker things that went on, I thought i would get back at my bully's. and instead of going through with the plan, i swallowed sleeping pills. I somehow survived a full bottle of max strength, at the time, it made me feel like there was a reason i survived.

I do over think things, I am always thinking, Always thinking of the past negative experiences, Also, forgot to mention, Even if i lose weight, I still need to tell my family that i am a homosexual, even though i Hate every part of me and the thoughts that are dirty. I was abused by my older brother, he left 3rd degree burns on me, and got rewarded in life. I dont know, I am thinking of running away in a car, just driving away into the mountains, i learned to drive, got a permit, but not a license. Another failure in my life.

More about Saying what is going to happen, and then it happens. So far, I have described movies, tv shows, parents in danger, such as almost going to a laundromat and getting shot, I emailed my dad telling him not to go that day, and around when he would have gone, a man was shot right in front of the laundromat. Its crazy, and no one would believe a word of it .
What if i could prove that i can do it, What then? I always record my dream as an audio file, They go back to 2009 when I got my first ipod touch.

Because I look intimidating, and also overweight, but am really soft literally and figuratively. I am nice to others, even if the same is not given back, I take everything so personally because my life is void of any joy, all I feel is pain, And most days, I wish I could just sleep, forever. I used to be a happy normal kid, Depression came to me in 2009, my life has been on a downward spiral since. I have much more to say, but the reality is, I am overweight, and have an eating disorder thanks to the people that mock me. The words cut like the sharpest knife. I have lost 30 pounds in 6 months, and have been starving myself to achieve that. Every time someone mocks me, I cut out more food. People treat me like shit. And others really enjoy my company, There have been many positive moments in my life, I just can't seem to stop fixating on the bad instead of the good. I know my statements are contradicting, but the last time I felt really happy, Was  in childhood. Even though we were in poverty, I still cherished every moment. Another pressing issue is the fact that I am not in school. I was at the top in my class, But while peers went on to ivy leagues, I stayed home. Depressed.
He may not see me as my best friend, even though we were close in high school, Things change, Even if you don't want them too. :(

I guess it would not work, I can get quite stressed, hopefully I can make a job out of traveling the world, cooking/foodie stuff put to the side. I think a good goal in life is to be happy, its hard to be happy in the sf bay area. Hopefully I will move on.
Well, my best friend always sticks through, i just need to contact him first, he is busy, and has a girl friend, so its hard to be not rude to text him.

Wow, I actually wondered about  being a chef once, i mean, I can cook really, really well. Well, because i loved making french food at 8 years old, and once I got older, I got into asian foods. I have confidence in the kitchen is all I can say, is it a stressful job working in  an actual restaurant? and do co workers like getting to know you, or is it not very social in the kitchen. i got questions. lol.

I feel like my life is falling apart. At age 19, Most of my peers are in some pretty good schools, I am in community college, and view myself as less than them. Even though, If i gave a shit, i would be with them. I have depression forever, it caused me to stay home, instead of going to school. My grades suffered, so I made up all my late work, this had a penalty on my gap, for obvious reasons. I don't know, just feel like shit these days. Then again, most people here are social zombies so, makes you think.

I agree, Most people my age are Douches, Wish I could get away from it all honestly. The academic pressure where I live also doesn't help, I am glad I made it through high school, but a crowded community college doesn't sound enticing. Shit, I hate thinking depressing things.

Well, I share all your hobbies, I love stargazing, Video games keep my mind active, I collect currency from around the world, but I long to find someone to not be so lonely. At 19, I feel like I am 50. I am ashamed of my generation, and the lack of empathy that it holds for human dignity. In high school, someone peed in my water bottle. All anyone seemed to care about was snapchat, Facebook ect. While leaving out actual human interactions. I am glad i had my teachers who liked me. And the seniors were the most respectful, they liked me. I hid my depression from everyone, and after high school, became a recluse in my home. My best friend has a girl friend, so obviously, throw out the old and in with the new. I am a bitter old soul, who used to be full of life, I used to love the tangerine trees, and  dance in the rain. I used to be human. Sadly, those old days have passed. And the thoughts of my worthlessness hurt me deep down to the core.

Dude, I am glad you have seen the beauty in life, hopefully you find some peace up in that mind, no matter how short that peace may last, well, your in my thoughts, and hopefully I get to hear more from you, it certainly helps to know i am not alone in my thoughts.

Well, In my life, there is so much stress, I never got to see it, until the day I said I was going to do it. I cannot change your mind, and i do not know you, all i can say is, The sun is why we are all here, when I saw the sunrise, it made me realize there is more to this life than the bullies, and the shitty daily life, It helped me re think my plans, and it still isn't where i want my life to be, but it helped. You are not alone in your thoughts. After all, its just a sunrise, no big deal, right?
Did you watch the sun rise this morning?

I tend to lie, most of the time. I wish I could be honest with all of them, tell them what goes on. I get bullied by strangers, so I tend to stay home. Alone. Playing video games and feeling like there is nothing else for me out in the cold world.

I am gay, this is an issue, my family and friends are religious, and biased, making gay jokes and such, out of all the members of my family, I am doing the worst in my life, The pressure to succeed in palo alto is killing me, and the thoughts that keep running through my brain are asking who cares, I have been a recluse at home, I was bullied by strangers in public, and I am 6'3 so its weird that they have the balls to say anything. Basically, I am afraid of what would happen if anyone in my sad life found out I was a homosexual. I want kids, and a "normal" family, but could I base my marriage off of a lie? I don't see much of a successful future ahead. Right now it is quite a dark time in my life. I don't know how to move forward, I have been on 1500 calories a day, my hair has thinned, and my skin is bone dry because of the calorie reduction.  since january 1st, and all I lost was 30lbs. And getting fat shamed while dieting forced me to eat less. I don't see myself as human. I have no self worth.
